source_notes: Fetched 2026-09-23. Names, years and Model Identifiers are verbatim from Apple "Identify your <X> model" pages: MacBook Air support.apple.com/en-us/102869, MacBook Pro 108052, MacBook 103257, iMac 108054 (includes iMac Pro), Mac mini 102852, Mac Pro 102887.

IMPORTANT: Apple identify pages do NOT list A-numbers (Model Number A####); they list order Part Numbers (e.g. MQD32xx/A). ALL a_numbers come from everymac.com (systems/by-identifier/all-<family>-model-numbers.html and ultimate-mac-lookup/?identify=A####).

t2 from Apple "Mac computers with the Apple T2 Security Chip" (support.apple.com/en-us/103265): MacBook Pro 2018-2020 (excl. M1), MacBook Air 2018-2020 (excl. M1), iMac (Retina 5K, 27-inch, 2020), iMac Pro, Mac mini (2018), Mac Pro 2019. iMac 2019 = no T2. MacBook Pro 2016/2017 Touch Bar = T1, not T2.

efi32: every Mac introduced 2008+ has 64-bit EFI, so efi32=false for all rows. 32-bit EFI Macs are 2006-2007 (MacBook1,1/2,1, MacBookPro1,x/2,x, iMac4,x/5,x, Macmini1,1/2,1, MacPro1,1/2,1, Xserve1,1): out of scope, but some share A-numbers with in-scope rows (see efi32_shared_a_numbers).

Apple pages start at ~2009 for most families; 2008 rows (MacBook Air Early/Late 2008, MacBook Early 2008 + Aluminum Late 2008, iMac Early 2008, iMac Mid 2009 20-inch, Mac Pro Early 2008) are everymac-sourced and their names are NOT Apple-verbatim.
MacBook Pro 17-inch Late 2008 = same machine as 17-inch Early 2008 (MacBookPro4,1, A1261) per everymac; Apple lists only the Early 2008 row.

Identifiers appended from everymac (not on Apple pages): MacBookPro15,3 (2018/2019 15-inch Vega configs; Apple lists 15,3 only under 2019), iMac14,3 (21.5-inch Late 2013 NVIDIA configs), Macmini5,3 (Mid 2011 server). iMac 21.5-inch Early 2013 i3 edu model = iMac13,1 per everymac (folded into Late 2012 row).
No 2008 Mac mini exists (Mid 2007 Macmini2,1, A1176, 32-bit EFI, sold until Mar 2009): out of scope.
UX: an A-number alone is ambiguous for most Intel Macs (see ambiguous_a_numbers). Ask for year/size, or read the Model Identifier (System Information / About This Mac) to disambiguate.
